data.name: Nirmay
data.long_meaning: Nirmay refers to the creator or maker in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir' meaning 'without' and 'may' meaning 'form'. This name is given to a child believed to have the potential to create or bring about positive changes.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, Nirmay symbolizes the divine power within each individual to create their own destiny.
